note: This file is a configuration dictionary (no callable functions, classes, or methods). It inherits from htc_r50_fpn_1x_coco.py and overrides the backbone to ResNeXt-101 32x4d, sets batch_size=1, and configures a 20-epoch training schedule with MultiStepLR milestones at [16, 19].
run_htc_resnext101_training: run HTC object detection training using a ResNeXt-101 32x4d backbone on COCO for 20 epochs
configure_backbone_resnext101: configure the HTC model backbone to use ResNeXt-101 32x4d with pretrained open-mmlab weights
set_learning_rate_schedule: set a MultiStepLR scheduler with milestones at epochs 16 and 19 and gamma 0.1
override_htc_config: override the base HTC ResNet-50 config to use ResNeXt-101 and a 20-epoch schedule
adjust_batch_size_workers: adjust the training dataloader to use batch_size 1 and num_workers 1
